BKClown-v1.1.0.description:
# BKClown v1.1.0
## Updates:
- Added an option to let you send lower children checks upon scoring higher ones "SendLowerChecksOnHigherChecks" (if toggled, when you scare 3 children it will send the checks for children 1 and 2 as well as opposed to just the scare 3 children check).

## Requirements:

- A Steam Copy of FFPS (Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator)

- Windows

## Setup:

- Create a folder named "BKCLOWN" in your main archipelago folder (or launching the client should do this automatically).
- Move your Steam copy of FFPS into the folder.
- Open the client, and run /patch.
- Open up the .exe titled BKCLOWN.exe and connect to your archipelago server in the top bar!
- Enjoy!
BKClown-v1.1.0.title: BKClown v1.1.0
